scope: One isolated namespace on the lab's pinned Kubernetes v1.36.1 kind cluster. Paired server-side dry-runs compare absent emptyDir sizeLimit and absent regular-container or init-container ephemeral-storage declarations before and after a case-owned ValidatingAdmissionPolicy. ResourceQuota admission is checked for aggregate declared requests and limits. One tiny marker is read below its bound. A paired disk-backed emptyDir comparison writes 1 MiB below and 3 MiB above a 2 MiB volume sizeLimit while each Pod has a 16 MiB aggregate container ephemeral-storage limit, isolating the volume-specific kubelet eviction. Native kubelet volume usage and node filesystem capacity are sampled on the disposable node.

checks.claim: Without case policy or quota, the API admits each bounded candidate
The policy rejects missing scratch bounds and preserves valid, over-budget declarations for quota evaluation
